394884.title: Intersecting families of permutations
394884.statement: Let $X\subset S_n$ be an intersecting family, meaning that for every $\sigma,\tau\in X$ there exists $i$ such that $\sigma(i)=\tau(i)$. The maximum possible size of $X$ is $(n-1)!$, and the extremal families are the cosets of stabilizers of points.
394884.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1782), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

394888.title: Minimum semidegree forcing a cycle of any fixed length through every vertex
394888.statement: For every integer $\ell\ge 4$, there exists an integer $n_0$ such that whenever $G$ is an oriented graph on $n\ge n_0$ vertices with minimum semidegree $\delta^0(G)\ge \lfloor n/3\rfloor+1$, every vertex of $G$ lies on a cycle of length $\ell$.
394888.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1782), page 31. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

394896.title: Density theorem for bipartite graphs
394896.statement: Let $H$ be a bipartite graph with $n$ vertices and maximum degree $\Delta\ge 1$. If $\varepsilon>0$ and $G$ is a graph with $N\ge 32\Delta\varepsilon^{-\Delta}n$ vertices and at least $\varepsilon\binom{N}{2}$ edges, then $H$ is a subgraph of $G$.
394896.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1782), page 50. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395055.title: Reconstruction of character-variety images from Witten–Reshetikhin–Turaev invariants
395055.statement: For a semisimple Lie group $G$, a positive integer $r$, a closed orientable surface $F$, and a $3$-manifold $M$ with boundary $F$, the Witten–Reshetikhin–Turaev quantum invariants $I_{G,r}(M)\in V_{G,r}(F)$, for all $r=2,3,\ldots$, determine the image of $X_G(M)$ in $X_G(\partial M)$.
395055.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1967), page 65. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395056.title: Sikora’s Conjecture 7 on quantum invariants and character varieties
395056.statement: For every complex reductive algebraic group $G$, the quantum $G$-invariants of a knot $K\subset S^3$ determine the image of $X_G(\pi_1(S^3\setminus K))$ in $X_G(\mathrm{torus})$. Equivalently, if knots $K_1,K_2$ have the same $G$-quantum invariants, then the images of $X_G(\pi_1(S^3\setminus K_i))$ in $X_G(\mathrm{torus})$ coincide.
395056.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1967), page 66. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395105.title: Universal clique-covering estimate for finite simple groups
395105.statement:
Does there exist a universal constant $c\ge 1$ such that, for every finite simple group $G$, the estimate
\[
\left(1-\frac{c}{m(G)}\right)\sigma(G)\le \omega(G)
\]
holds, where $\omega(G)$ is the clique number of the generating graph, $\sigma(G)$ is the minimum size of a covering of $G$ by proper subgroups, and $m(G)$ is the minimal index of a proper subgroup of $G$?
395105.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1973), page 9. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395117.title: Periodic points of the arithmetic trace-map reductions
395117.statement: For a sequence defining the map $\varphi(x,y)=[y^{-1}xy,x^{-1}]$ and its trace-map factor $\widetilde\psi_{\varphi}:\mathbb A^3_{s,u,t}\to\mathbb A^3_{s,u,t}$, determine conditions under which the reduction $\widetilde\psi_{\varphi}:\mathbb A^3(\mathbb F_p)\to\mathbb A^3(\mathbb F_p)$ has a periodic point for every prime $p$.
395117.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1973), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395121.title: Local minimization of absolute Gaussian curvature for a polyhedral cone
395121.statement: Given a piecewise-linear embedding $C$ of $S^1$ into $\[3$ whose vertices have rational coordinates, find a point $q\in\mathbb{R}^3\setminus C$ such that the piecewise-linear surface formed by taking, for every edge of $C$, one triangle with vertex $q$ has minimum absolute Gaussian curvature.
395121.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/29](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2040), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395300.title: Chromatic number of point–rectangle hypergraphs
395300.statement: For a finite set of $n$ points $P\subset\mathbb{R}^2$, form the hypergraph with vertex set $P$ and hyperedges $P\cap R$, where $R$ ranges over axis-parallel rectangles and $|P\cap R|\ge 2$. Is the maximum possible chromatic number of such a hypergraph $O(n^\varepsilon)$ for every $\varepsilon>0$?
395300.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2090), page 21. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395393.title: Crossing number of the toroidal grid graph $T_{8,8}$
395393.statement: The crossing number of the smallest toroidal grid graph $T_{8,8}$ is still unknown and is conjectured to be $48$.
395393.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2008/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2489), page 44. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395495.title: Distribution of the martingale limit in the large-\m m-ary search tree
395495.statement: Determine the distribution of the complex random variable $W^{DT}$ appearing as the martingale limit in the $m$-ary search-tree composition-vector asymptotics for $m\ge 27$.
395495.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/03](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3386), page 10. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395538.title: Strictness of the Hersch–Payne–Schiffer inequality for higher Steklov eigenvalues
395538.statement:
Determine whether, for every simply-connected bounded planar domain $\Omega$ with Lipschitz boundary, the Hersch–Payne–Schiffer inequality is strict for every integer $k\ge 2$, i.e. whether
$$\sigma_k(\Omega)\,L(\partial\Omega)<2\pi k.$$
395538.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/06](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3389), page 15. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395606.title: The other direction of the UGA VIGRE conjecture on Specht-module complexity
395606.statement: Resolve the other direction of Conjecture 1 (UGA VIGRE): for a Specht module $S^\lambda$ in a block of weight $w$, determine whether $\lambda$ not being $p\times p$ implies that the complexity of $S^\lambda$ is $w$. Here $\lambda\vdash d$ is $p\times p$ when $\lambda=(\lambda_1^{a_1},\lambda_2^{a_2},\ldots,\lambda_s^{a_s})$ with $p\mid\lambda_i$ and $p\mid a_i$ for every $i$.
395606.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/10](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3393), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395627.title: Robust stability radius under parametric uncertainty in biochemical reaction networks
395627.statement:
Given nominal parameter values $p_0$, compute a robust stability radius $\psi^*$ such that, for every $x\in\mathbb{R}^n$ and $p\in\mathbb{R}^q$ satisfying $Sv(x,p)=0$ and
$$
\frac{p_{0,i}}{\psi^*}<p_i<p_{0,i}\psi^*,\qquad i=1,\ldots,q,
$$
the Jacobian $S\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}(x,p)$ is Hurwitz.
395627.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3394), page 72. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395708.title: General Operator Corona Problem
395708.statement: Find a preferably local necessary and sufficient condition for a bounded operator-valued function $F\in H^\infty_{E^*\to E}$ to have a left inverse in $H^\infty_{E^*\to E}$; that is, determine conditions ensuring the existence of $G\in H^\infty_{E\to E^*}$ such that $G(z)F(z)\equiv I$ for all $z\in\mathbb D$.
395708.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3470), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395764.title: Asymptotic Vickrey cost for the random non-bipartite matching problem
395764.statement:
For a minimum-weight perfect matching in the complete graph $K_n$ with i.i.d. edge weights distributed either uniformly on $[0,1]$ or exponentially with parameter $1$, is the expected Vickrey cost asymptotically twice the expected minimum cost; that is, does
$$\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{VCG}_n]\sim 2\,\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{OPT}_n]\qquad(n\to\infty)?$$
395764.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/23](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3473), page 63. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395765.title: Doubly exponential lower bound for the two-color 3-uniform Ramsey number
395765.statement: Determine whether there exists a constant $c>0$ such that $r_3(n,n)>2^{2^{cn}}$ for all sufficiently large $n$.
395765.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/23](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/3473), page 66. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395899.title: On the extremality of an 80-dimensional lattice
395899.statement: The specific even unimodular lattice of dimension $80$ described by Watkins is extremal: the minimum length of a nonzero vector is $8$. Its automorphism group contains a subgroup isomorphic to $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_{79})$.
395899.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4076), page 44. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395900.title: Extremality of a specific 80-dimensional even unimodular lattice
395900.statement: The specific even unimodular lattice of dimension $80$ described in the report is extremal: its minimum length is $8$, equivalently it has no nonzero vectors of norm $2$, $4$, or $6$.
395900.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4076), page 46. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

395912.title: Three-dimensional stability of Burgers vortices for arbitrary circulation
395912.statement: Determine the three-dimensional stability of Burgers vortices with respect to three-dimensional perturbations for arbitrary circulation numbers, in both the symmetric and non-symmetric cases.
395912.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4077), page 9. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396080.title: Unique Games characterization of CSP approximation thresholds
396080.statement: For every finite-domain CSP \(\Lambda\) and every \(c>0\), is \(\alpha_{\Lambda,c}\) the correct approximation threshold for instances of value \(c\) on \(\Lambda\), where \(\alpha_{\Lambda,c}\) is the largest \(\alpha\) such that, for every \(\tau>0\), there exists a \(\tau\)-pseudorandom \((c,\alpha)\)-approximate DDF?
396080.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/52](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4135), page 36. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396107.title: Minimizers of lattice zeta functions
396107.statement:
Let $C$ be a smooth convex body with center at $o$, let $\lVert\cdot\rVert_C$ be the corresponding norm on $E^d$, and define
$$
\zeta_C(L,s)=\sum_{l\in L\setminus\{o\}}\frac{1}{\lVert l\rVert_C^s},\qquad s>d.
$$
Determine, for a given $s>d$ or for all sufficiently large $s$, the lattices $L$ of determinant $1$ that minimize $\zeta_C(L,s)$.
396107.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4136), page 42. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396135.title: Additivity of minimum-output Rényi entropy for p > 2
396135.statement: For every $p>2$, there exist quantum channels for which the minimum-output Rényi entropy is nonadditive.
396135.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2009/56](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4139), page 14. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396169.title: Determine the minimizer of maximal affine surface area
396169.statement: Determine the convex set $K_{\\min}$ such that, for all $n$-dimensional convex $K \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, $$\Omega_{\max}(K_{\min}) \leq \Omega_{\max}(K) \leq \Omega_{\max}(B).$$
396169.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/04](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4199), page 9. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396217.title: Fujita–Kawarabayashi connectivity-keeping subgraph conjecture
396217.statement:
For all positive integers $k,m$, there is a least non-negative integer $f_k(m)$ such that every finite simple $k$-connected graph $G$ with minimum degree
$$
\delta(G)\ge \left\lfloor\frac{3k}{2}\right\rfloor-1+f_k(m)
$$
contains a connected subgraph $W$ of exact order $m$ such that
$$
\kappa\bigl(G-V(W)\bigr)\ge k.
$$
396217.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4212), page 36. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396218.title: Existence of connectivity-keeping subgraphs isomorphic to a prescribed tree
396218.statement:
For every positive integer $k$ and every tree $T$, there exists a least non-negative integer $g_k(T)$ such that every $k$-connected graph $G$ with minimum degree
$$
\delta(G)\ge \left\lfloor\frac{3k}{2}\right\rfloor-1+g_k(T)
$$
contains a subgraph $S$ isomorphic to $T$ such that
$$
\kappa\bigl(G-V(S)\bigr)\ge k.
$$
396218.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4212), page 36. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396219.title: Mader’s connectivity-keeping trees conjecture
396219.statement: For every positive integer $k$ and every tree $T$, let $g_k(T)$ be the least non-negative integer such that every $k$-connected graph $G$ with minimum degree $\delta(G)\ge \left\lfloor\frac{3k}{2}\right\rfloor-1+g_k(T)$ contains a subgraph $S$ isomorphic to $T$ such that $\kappa(G-V(S))\ge k$. Conjecture 1 (W. Mader): $g_k(T)=|T|$.
396219.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4212), page 37. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396220.title: Richter’s bounded maximum-degree conjecture for crossing-critical graphs
396220.statement: For every positive integer $k$, there exists an integer $D(k)$ such that every $k$-crossing-critical graph has maximum degree less than $D(k)$, where a graph is $k$-crossing-critical if its crossing number is at least $k$ but every proper subgraph has crossing number less than $k$.
396220.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4212), page 39. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396321.title: Compatibility conditions for Moufang quadrangles of type $E_8$
396321.statement: For every Moufang quadrangle $\Delta$ of type $E_8$ whose defining field $K$ is complete with respect to a discrete valuation, do the valuation-induced maps $\varphi_\alpha:U_\alpha^*\to\mathbb{Z}$ satisfy the compatibility conditions required to construct a Bruhat–Tits building $X$ with building at infinity $X_\infty=\Delta$?
396321.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4333), page 31. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396552.title: Finite colorings preventing monochromatic factorizations of Sturmian words
396552.statement: Given a Sturmian word $W$, does there exist a finite non-empty color set $C$ and a coloring $c:F^{+}(W)\to C$ such that, for every factorization $W=U_0U_1U_2\cdots$, there exist indices $i\ne j$ for which $c(U_i)\ne c(U_j)$? If so, what is the smallest possible cardinality of $C$?
396552.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4425), page 48. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396652.title: Immersion dimension of real projective spaces
396652.statement: Determine the immersion dimension $I(n)$ as a function of $n$ for all natural numbers $n\ge 1$, where $I(n)$ is the smallest natural number $k$ such that the real projective space $P^n$ admits a smooth immersion $P^n\looparrowright\mathbb{R}^k$.
396652.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/47](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4529), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396740.title: Euler–Poincaré pairings for arbitrary irreducible affine Hecke-algebra modules
396740.statement: Compute the Euler–Poincaré pairing $EP_H(\π,\π')$ for arbitrary irreducible $H$-modules $\π,\π'$, where $H$ is an affine Hecke algebra with positive parameters.
396740.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2010/52](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4534), page 27. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396805.title: Validity of linear inequalities between subgraph densities
396805.statement:
Given fixed simple graphs $F_1,\ldots,F_n$ and coefficients $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ (arbitrary real coefficients, or rational coefficients in an algorithmic setting), determine whether
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_i\,t(F_i,G)\ge 0
\]
holds for every simple graph $G$, where $t(F,G)$ is the density of $F$ in $G$. The report states that this decision problem is undecidable.
396805.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4791), page 5. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396813.title: Asymptotic minimum size of 5-cycle-semisaturated graphs
396813.statement:
Conjecture 2. The minimum number of edges in an $n$-vertex $C_5$-semisaturated graph satisfies
\[
\operatorname{ssat}(n,C_5)=\frac{11}{8}n+O(1).
\]
396813.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4791), page 16. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396816.title: Erdős–Hajnal tournament-timidness conjecture
396816.statement:
For every finite tournament $H$, there exist a real number $\varepsilon$ with $0\leq\varepsilon<1$ and a constant $c$ such that every finite tournament $G$ containing no subtournament isomorphic to $H$ satisfies
\[
\chi(G)\leq c\,|V(G)|^{\varepsilon}.
\]
Here $\chi(G)$ is the minimum number of transitive subsets into which $V(G)$ can be partitioned.
396816.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4791), page 22. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

396822.title: Simonovits–Sós conjecture on triangle-intersecting families of graphs
396822.statement: A family of graphs \(\mathcal F\) on a fixed set of \(n\) vertices is triangle-intersecting if, for every \(G,H\in\mathcal F\), the intersection \(G\cap H\) contains a triangle. The Simonovits–Sós conjecture states that the largest such families are precisely the families obtained by fixing a specific triangle and taking all graphs containing it; their size is \(2^{\binom n2}/8\).
396822.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/4791), page 33. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397266.title: Construct low-degree irreducible representations of alternating groups
397266.statement: Construct all irreducible representations of $A_n$ over $\c9bb F_q$ of degree $d$, where $n \le 25$ and $d \le n^3$.
397266.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11129), page 44. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397285.title: Insuring against loss of evidence and capital
397285.statement: Under the protocol in which $X_0=1$, ${}^{I}K_0=1$, Investor announces $p_t\in\mathbb{R}$, Market announces $X_t\in[0,\infty)$, and ${}^{I}K_t:={}^{I}K_{t-1}+p_t(X_t-X_{t-1})$ for $t=1,2,\ldots$, set $X_t^*:=\max_{s\le t}X_s$. Determine when Investor has a trading strategy guaranteeing ${}^{I}K_t\ge F(X_t^*)$ for all $t$, where $F(y)\to\infty$ almost as fast as $y$ as $y\to\infty$.
397285.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/42](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11134), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397304.title: Erdős distinct-distances conjecture in the plane
397304.statement: For every set $S$ of $s$ points in the plane, the number of distinct pairwise distances determined by points of $S$ is at least $\Omega\!\left(\frac{s}{\sqrt{\log s}}\right)$; equivalently, the minimum possible number of distinct distances determined by an $s$-point planar set is $\Omega\!\left(\frac{s}{\sqrt{\log s}}\right)$.
397304.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11136), page 9. Canonicalized from 5 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397323.title: Füredi–Hajnal conjecture
397323.statement: For every permutation matrix $P$, the extremal function $\operatorname{ex}_P(n)$—the maximum number of $1$-entries in an $n\times n$ $(0,1)$-matrix avoiding $P$—is linear in $n$.
397323.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11136), page 46. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397324.title: Raz’s exponential-bound question for permutation families of bounded VC-dimension
397324.statement: Let \4S_n\4 be the set of all permutations of \4[n]\4. For a set \4P\subseteq S_n\4, define its VC-dimension using restrictions to ordered tuples of positions, and let \4r_k(n)\4 be the largest size of a family \4P\4 with VC-dimension \4k\4. Raz asked whether an exponential upper bound on \4r_k(n)\4 can be found for every \4k\ge 3\4.
397324.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2011/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11136), page 46. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397707.title: Unimodular triangulations of smooth lattice polytopes
397707.statement: Does every smooth lattice polytope have a unimodular triangulation? Here smooth means that the polytope is simple and the $d$ edge vectors from any vertex to its neighbors have determinant $\71$, i.e. form a basis for $\mathbb{Z}^d$; unimodular means that each simplex has volume $1/d!$ (the minimum possible).
397707.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2012/24](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11786), page 76. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397736.title: Global well-posedness and regularity for three-dimensional Navier–Stokes
397736.statement:
For the incompressible Navier–Stokes equation on \(\Omega=\mathbb{R}^{3}\) or \(\mathbb{T}^{3}\), with viscosity \(\nu=1\), divergence-free mean-zero initial data \(\vec u_{0}\), and
\[
\partial_t\vec u=\Delta\vec u-P\nabla\cdot(\vec u\otimes\vec u),\qquad \nabla\cdot\vec u=0,\qquad \vec u(x,0)=\vec u_0(x),
\]
determine whether solutions are globally well posed and remain regular for all \(t>0\).
397736.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2012/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11788), page 44. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397751.title: Technical gradient condition for four-dimensional shrinking Ricci solitons
397751.statement:
For every four-dimensional shrinking gradient Ricci soliton $(M^4,g,f)$, prove that there exists a technical constant $C_{\mathrm{tech}}<\infty$ such that
\[
|\nabla f|(x)\ge \frac{1}{C_{\mathrm{tech}}}
\quad\text{whenever }d(x,p)\ge C_{\mathrm{tech}},
\]
where $p$ is a minimum point of the shrinker potential $f$.
397751.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2012/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11789), page 32. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397797.title: Kodaira dimensions of Prym moduli spaces in genera 9–12
397797.statement:
Determine the Kodaira dimension of the Prym moduli space $\cR_g$ for each $g
tu0005cin\tu0005b9,12\d$.
397797.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2012/30](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11792), page 13. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

397810.title: Effective cone of the Hilbert scheme of points on \(\mathbf P^2\)
397810.statement: Determine the effective cone of \(H_n\), where \(H_n\) is the Hilbert scheme of zero-dimensional subschemes of \(\mathbf P^2\) of degree \(n\), for every \(n\).
397810.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2012/30](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/11792), page 45. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

398149.title: Variance conjecture for hyperplane projections of the cross-polytope
398149.statement:
There exists an absolute constant $C$ such that for every hyperplane $H\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, if $X$ is uniformly distributed on the orthogonal projection $P_H B_1^n$ of the unit ball $B_1^n$ of $\ell_1^n$ onto $H$, then
\[
\operatorname{Var}|X|^2\le C\lambda_X^2\,\mathbb{E}|X|^2,
\]
where $\lambda_X^2$ is the largest eigenvalue of the covariance matrix of $X$.
398149.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2012/59](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12182), page 13. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

398150.title: General variance conjecture for centered log-concave random vectors
398150.statement:
There exists an absolute constant $C$ such that, for every centered log-concave random vector $X$ in $\[1mR\[0mn$, one has
$$
\operatorname{Var}|X|^{2}\le C\lambda_X^{2}\,\mathbb{E}|X|^{2},
$$
where $\lambda_X$ denotes the largest eigenvalue of the covariance matrix of $X$.
398150.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2012/59](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12182), page 13. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

398218.title: Maximum number of 5-cycles in triangle-free graphs
398218.statement:
For all sufficiently large positive integers $\l$ and every integer $a$ with $0\le a\le 4$, the maximum number of copies of the cycle of length $5$ in a triangle-free graph with $5\ell+a$ vertices is
$$
\ell^{5-a}(\ell+1)^a.
$$
398218.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12330), page 44. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

398225.title: Theorem 41: Edge connectivity forcing immersions
398225.statement: There exists a function $g$ satisfying the following. Let $k\ge 4$ and $n\ge 1$ be positive integers. Then, for all graphs $H$ with maximum degree $k$ on $n$ vertices and for all $k$-edge-connected graphs $G$, either $G$ admits an immersion of $H$, or $G$ has tree-cut width at most $g(k,n)$­­.
398225.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12330), page 57. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
